name: Neo1
dof_breakdown: 39 joints on in-house miniature digital hydraulic actuators (~1 kg each), 2 electric forearm rotations
summary: A 4 m, 1.2 t hydraulic-electric humanoid from a Beijing company founded in 2024 by Tsinghua-trained engineers. It was shown at WRC 2026 and with JD Industrial at CIIF 2026, and the company claims a 500 kg two-arm payload. So far it is a demonstration unit: a computer runs a set program, power comes through a cable, and it has done no site work.
notable: Largest humanoid in the index (4 m, 1.2 t)

sources.title: Neo1 stands about 13 ft (4 m) tall — New Atlas
